status: PLANNED_NOT_EXECUTED (light phase; A1 schedules the heavy window)

census_scope.universe: 410-filer SEC panel (pinned PIT store, sha256 f53eb371...df955; CIK->ticker mapping archived at .staging_prices_v6/summaries/panel_cik_to_ticker.json)
census_scope.window: S0 folds 2018-04-04..2025-07-24 (download full history per symbol; census measures the S0 intersection)
census_scope.endpoint: https://stooq.com/q/d/l/?s=<symbol>.us&i=d (parameter semantics d1/d2=YYYYMMDD verified operationally in probes)
census_scope.politeness: >=2s inter-request spacing, honest UA, no credentials; see access-channel blocker below

census_measures_per_symbol: first/last served date; served-history depth vs S0
row count vs expected NYSE sessions inside S0 (USEquityRegularCalendar, frozen 2010-2030 table)
missing session days (gaps) listed explicitly — never gap-patched
duplicate dates, non-ascending delivery, OHLC interval violations (parser fails loud)
last-date < 2025-07-24 => delisted/suspended survival flag (names keep history; never silently dropped — plan §2 leg 3)
census_measures_panel_wide: panel coverage fraction per decision date (fraction of 410 with a served bar on/preceding the date)
delisted-name survival count and histogram of last dates
symbol-suffix taxonomy encountered (.us, .xus?, duplicates) and identity collisions
revision/vintage behavior: re-download a fixed 10-symbol subset after >=24h and diff bytes; report added/changed rows (this is the ONLY provable revision test)

expected_volume.requests: 410 (one full-history CSV per symbol) + 10 revision-check re-downloads
expected_volume.bytes: ~0.5-1.5 MB per symbol full history => ~0.2-0.6 GB raw, gitignored, sha256-manifested
expected_volume.duration: >= 410 * 2s spacing ~= 14 min minimum; budget 1-2 h with retries

access_channel_blocker_for_owner.finding: plain-HTTP clients receive a JS proof-of-work challenge on every stooq endpoint (both domains); browser-equivalent rendering works but is summary-lossy and cannot serve as a 410-symbol bulk channel
options: A: authorize a scripted-access approach that satisfies stooq's browser check (owner decision; agent cannot invent consent)
B: authorize an owner-provided compliant access path (e.g., direct licensed feed)
C: accept BLOCKED_DATA_AUTHORITY close for the price leg (legitimate per plan §2)

frozen_conflict_policy.default: single-source (Stooq) if it is the only authorized source

if_a_second_source_is_authorized.per_row_provenance: every row carries source_id + retrieved_time_utc + raw_sha256
if_a_second_source_is_authorized.primary_role: Stooq fills the series; the second source NEVER silently gap-patches (handbook §11.5)
if_a_second_source_is_authorized.conflict_resolution: on same-day value conflict: primary wins, conflict row written to a quarantine list published in the census; resolution is an owner-visible decision, never silent
if_a_second_source_is_authorized.no_blending: no averaged/interpolated prices from multiple sources, ever
